title: Governed Resource Discovery Convergence
core_principle: DISCOVERY IS EVIDENCE. DISCOVERY IS NOT AUTHORITY.
primary_invariant: DISCOVERED != REGISTERED != AVAILABLE != ELIGIBLE != SELECTED != AUTHORIZED != BOUND != ATTEMPTED != USED != VERIFIED

components.name: CanonicalResourceDiscoveryService
components.responsibility: Accepts adapters, orchestrates observations, normalizes evidence, deduplicates, produces deterministic snapshots, exposes discovery truth. Never executes, invokes, authorizes, binds, or mutates RRM.

components.name: DiscoveryRegistry
components.responsibility: Stores discovery evidence only. Presence means observed, not available/eligible/authorized/bound/trusted.

components.name: ResourceDiscoveryEvidence
components.responsibility: Immutable typed evidence record of a single observation with provenance, confidence, health, credential metadata.

components.name: ResourceDiscoverySnapshot
components.responsibility: Deterministic read-only snapshot of all discovery evidence with optional derived RRM cross-reference.

components.name: ResourceDiscoveryCorrelation
components.responsibility: Derived read-only cross-reference between discovery evidence and RRM truth.

components.name: ResourceDiscoveryAdapter
components.responsibility: Narrow protocol for pluggable observation sources. Returns evidence only.

components.name: ResourceDiscoveryStatus
components.responsibility: Discovery-specific states: OBSERVED, STALE, REVOKED, UNAVAILABLE_AT_SOURCE, UNKNOWN, INVALID.

components.name: ResourceDiscoveryKind
components.responsibility: Observed resource category: PROVIDER, TOOL, CAPABILITY, ENVIRONMENT, AGENT, LOCAL_PROGRAM, MCP_RESOURCE, CONNECTED_SERVICE, DEVICE, CUSTOM.

components.name: ResourceRegistrationProposal
components.responsibility: Non-productive typed proposal for future registration. Never registers anything. Never mutates RRM.

components.name: RegistryResourceManager (RRM)
components.responsibility: Sole runtime availability/eligibility authority. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: CanonicalResourceBindingAuthority
components.responsibility: Sole runtime binding gatekeeper. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: CanonicalCapabilityRegistry
components.responsibility: Runtime execution binding registry. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: MissionEngine
components.responsibility: Sole Mission identity/lifecycle authority. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: ToolAuthorizationGate
components.responsibility: Tool authorization decisions. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: CanonicalConfirmationService
components.responsibility: Typed confirmation. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: VerificationGate
components.responsibility: Post-execution verification. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: MissionCompletionGate
components.responsibility: Sole Mission completion authority. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: CanonicalProviderAuthority
components.responsibility: Provider selection/invocation. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: CanonicalMemoryService
components.responsibility: Memory scoping. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: CanonicalAgentFactory
components.responsibility: Agent creation. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: CanonicalAgentRegistry
components.responsibility: Agent registry. Unchanged by M16.

components.name: GovernedAgent
components.responsibility: Passive identity/lifecycle. May consume discovery as read-only context; cannot promote it.

components.name: ProductBridge
components.responsibility: Transport/presentation. Discovery diagnostics are read-only if exposed.

components.name: SymbioticLayer
components.responsibility: Host environment observation. May be an adapter source.

components.name: Legacy Discovery/Catalog Mechanisms
components.responsibility: May coexist temporarily. Must not override canonical RRM or binding authorities.

authority_rules.rule: Discovery is read-only evidence, not runtime authority.
Discovery does not create runtime availability.
Discovery does not create runtime eligibility.
Discovery does not create authorization.
Discovery does not create executable binding.
Discovery does not invoke provider/tool/resource.
RRM remains sole runtime availability/eligibility authority.
Existing canonical execution path remains mandatory.
Agent cannot promote discovery into authority.
Compatibility cannot promote discovery into authority.
Discovery identity/source provenance is preserved.
Stale/replaced observations cannot silently substitute identity.
Discovery metadata cannot inject authority.
Zero-provider truth remains intact.
RA-13-01 remains fixed.
M14 confirmation/resume authority remains intact.
M15 Agent authority containment remains intact.
M11-M15 regressions pass.
No productive external execution is introduced.
Full available regression suite passes.

obligations.obligation: Every discovery adapter must return typed ResourceDiscoveryEvidence.
Every evidence record must preserve source, source_type, observed_at, observed_by.
Confidence values must be clamped to [0.0, 1.0].
Discovery status must not reuse RRM lifecycle statuses.
Snapshots must be deterministic given the same registry state.
RRM cross-reference must be derived, never written.
Revocation must fail closed (missing ID returns False).
Staleness must fail closed (missing ID returns False).
Discovery must not write to project/user memory.
Discovery evidence must be treated as untrusted input.
Adapter errors must not propagate as execution failures.
Proposal must not mutate any runtime state.

discovery_flow: EXPLICIT canonical registration/projection path (NOT part of M16)

discovery_statuses.meaning: Evidence not refreshed, may be outdated

correlation_statuses.meaning: Resource found in RRM but not eligible
Resource found in RRM and eligible
